tools.name: pc_status
tools.description: Return a minimal read-only Windows/Python capability summary. It omits usernames, IP addresses, environment variables, and credentials.

tools.name: list_workspace
tools.description: List a bounded non-recursive directory under D:\CLAUDE after local user approval. Sensitive directory names are blocked.

tools.name: read_workspace_text
tools.description: Read at most 65536 bytes from an allowlisted text file under D:\CLAUDE after local user approval. Path escape and sensitive directories are blocked.

tools.name: run_diagnostic
tools.description: Run one fixed read-only diagnostic after local user approval. No arbitrary command or arguments are accepted.

tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List targetable visible Windows top-level windows through the trusted Computer Use adapter. Security, terminal, credential, and agent-control windows are excluded.

tools.name: observe_window
tools.description: Capture a bounded fresh PNG observation for exactly one previously returned window. Returns dimensions, DPI, a screenshot hash, and an expiring observation ID.

tools.name: computer_action
tools.description: Perform exactly one approved safe action against the exact window and fresh observation, then return a fresh screenshot observation. No shell, security UI, credentials, destructive actions, or stale coordinates.
